descriptor.name: Andhra Pradesh cadastral maps — indianopenmaps tile snapshot (APSAC_AP_Cadastrals)
descriptor.scope: Cadastral parcels of Andhra Pradesh from the APSAC_AP_Cadastrals snapshot that ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals collected from the government map service and serves as vector tiles at indianopenmaps.com. Parcels are rebuilt from zoom-13 tiles. Coverage follows the villages in that snapshot and can omit city cores.

evidence: Frozen packet providerReuse.scopeEvidence describes Andhra Pradesh cadastral coverage and limits candidates to IN-AP; packet city is Vijayawada (10677).

Snapshot publisher dataset APSAC_AP_Cadastrals identifies Andhra Pradesh APSAC Cadastrals and https://apsac.ap.gov.in/ as its origin. Original-government purpose, city scope and native CRS remain independently unverified; see evidence/source-inspection.json.
